title: Protect each valid block rather than only an all-valid register
statement: Capture maps code basis states to definite joint occupations inside local spin zero. A joint occupation-diagonal interaction with no within-pattern spin-multiplicity action reduces each captured valid block code even when other blocks/memory are arbitrary; compensated return preserves that block computational subspace on the full local Fock space. Such a potential may still cause logical dephasing: no leakage is not error-free computation. An all-valid-only vanishing term is insufficient: leaked control Q_A tensor sum_b X_L,b activates many target errors at one leakage amplitude. Actual collective S_b tensor B_b acts trivially on every still-neutral block, also during gates. Separately, bounded two-body spin-only cross-block terms preserving separate singlet codes instantaneously have no projected entangling action; virtual excursions, higher bodies, measurements or charge degrees remain outside that obstruction.

requires: Four one-orbital sites/four electrons per computational block, spin-zero code; nominal controls preserve EACH block total spin throughout charge excursions. Collective bath may be shared, fast and noncommuting but must annihilate still-neutral blocks individually.

Coherent scalar U>0,g>=0 and detuning control, actual addressable capacitive hold/isolation, source/readout qualification, fresh local nominal meters/reservoirs and protected classical control. Earlier broad positive operator-coupling intervals do not supply these calibrations.

Weak residual terms bounded on FULL admitted local/leakage spaces with summable per-block joint norm row sum; physical fermion parity, loss/reservoir modes and finite-orbital domain are qualified. Actual fault-tolerant gadget/routing/ancilla resources supply finite compiler pair count A.
